newsitem.title: JAPAN: MARUKO SEC TO SELL OSAKA EXCHANGE MEMBERSHIP.
newsitem.headline: MARUKO SEC TO SELL OSAKA EXCHANGE MEMBERSHIP.

text.p: Small brokerage Maruko Securities Co Ltd said on Thursday said that it had decided to sell its Osaka Securities Exchange membership to U.S. brokerage Bear Stearns Japan Ltd.
The brokerage said in a statement that after approval by the Osaka Securities Exchange, the membership would change hands on October 1.
A Maruko spokesman said that the membership would be a limited one, which allows the holder to trade stock futures and options but not cash stocks.
The membership will be sold for about 200 million yen.

"It seams that Bear Stearns is planning to emphasise its derivatives business and our membership was perfect for its needs," he said. Maruko is due to merge with Osaka-based Daika Securities Co Ltd on October 1.
